planner.summary: Add a // operation to calculate() and expose it in the console menu.
steps: Add a // branch to calculate() that uses Python's floor division.
Raise ValueError when the divisor is zero, matching the existing / behavior.
Add // to the accepted operators and the menu text in main().
edge_cases: Negative operands (floor rounds toward negative infinity)

programmer_summary: Added a // branch to calculate() with a zero-divisor check and added // to the console menu.

reviewer.summary: The new // branch mirrors the existing division handling and the menu accepts the new operator.
limitations: Review is based on reading the code; no tests were run.
